agreements: Gearbox v1 verified baseline and Step009 Heartbeat verified foundation remain preserved; this review changes no formal state and claims no C PASS.
Heartbeat, poll, retry, reconnect, wait, scheduler wake, window age, uptime and self-test loops remain zero Experience.
v2 uses strict_bool for inherited routing booleans and v2.1 uses strict bool for secretary freshness, authority conflict and direct event verification type boundaries.
v2.1 handles terminal N/R before anti-thrash numeric parsing and bounds non-Mapping ledger elements.
v2 rejects missing event_id before verifier parsing, so identity-less malformed records are bounded ignores in current bytes.
v2 real_experience_claim_allowed additionally requires verification_stage=C_VERIFIED; this is useful fail-closed hardening but still does not establish verifier provenance.
DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND are operational progress only under v2.1 and must not become verified Experience, P_base, Trust, Identity, Personality or Governance evidence.
verified_progress_density is currently reason-only and does not raise selected gear; it remains observational only.
GEARBOX_V2_1_CONTRACT correctly keeps speedup NOT_YET_STATISTICALLY_ESTABLISHED and formal_mutation_allowed remains false.

disagreements.finding: Material new defect: aggregate_experience_events adds event_id to the transient seen set before proving that the record is an accepted verified or operational event. A valid-ID UNKNOWN/WAIT/unverified-verified record can therefore consume e1 and cause a later corrected legitimate e1 in the same batch to be classified as duplicate, producing denial-of-evidence and first-writer-wins semantics.
disagreements.required_change: Reserve/consume canonical event identity only after schema, event-kind, evidence and verifier/operational acceptance succeed. Invalid or zero-credit claims must not consume identity. Same event_id with a different binding must be explicit IDENTITY_CONFLICT, not silent duplicate.

disagreements.finding: Material new defect: duplicate detection occurs after strict verifier parsing. After a valid e1 has already been accepted in a batch, a replay carrying the same event_id but malformed independently_verified can raise GearboxGuardError before the code reaches `event_id in seen`, aborting later valid records. A duplicate that should be a no-op can therefore become a batch denial-of-evidence primitive.
disagreements.required_change: Use a canonical identity/binding registry that can reject exact replay before reparsing irrelevant mutable fields, or parse a bounded immutable event envelope first. Exact replay must be deterministic NO_OP; malformed rebinding must be bounded IDENTITY_CONFLICT and must not abort unrelated records.

disagreements.finding: aggregate_experience_events parses independently_verified for every Mapping with a non-empty event_id before deciding whether the event kind is verified, operational or zero-credit. WAIT/HEARTBEAT/DURABLE_PROGRESS with malformed verifier metadata can abort the batch even when verifier metadata is irrelevant to that credit class.
disagreements.required_change: Classify canonical EventKind before verifier parsing. Parse verifier evidence only for verified kinds; operational/zero-credit records must use an explicit bounded schema and may not censor later independent evidence.

disagreements.finding: select_gear_v2 normalizes current_gear with strip().upper(), while select_gear_v2_1 later rereads raw current_gear using upper() without strip before numeric parsing. An input accepted by inherited v2 such as ' G3 ' can crash the wrapper.
disagreements.required_change: Normalize current_gear once at one typed boundary or derive it from a canonical runtime-state receipt; v2.1 must not reparse raw caller bytes.

disagreements.finding: experience_candidate_delta normalizes event_kind with str(...), but select_gear_v2 later calls event_kind.upper() on the original caller object. Non-string input can produce an uncaught AttributeError after partial processing.
disagreements.required_change: Create one canonical typed EventKind intake before routing/credit logic and use only the normalized value throughout v2/v2.1.

disagreements.finding: secretary_signal_fresh and authority_conflict remain caller declarations. Strict bool proves type only, not source, timestamp/TTL, revocation, policy or runtime/install binding.
disagreements.required_change: Consume trusted SecretarySignalEnvelope and AuthorityDecisionEnvelope with replay-resistant provenance/freshness binding.

disagreements.finding: authority_conflict only replaces secretary_level with UNKNOWN; it does not load or enforce the actual fresh authority decision. Permissive fallback kwargs can still determine routing.
disagreements.required_change: On authority conflict, project the exact trusted authority snapshot or fail closed; stale, revoked or cross-scope authority evidence must be rejected.

disagreements.finding: Secretary freshness guards only secretary_level. Numeric pressure fields have no per-field provenance/freshness binding, so stale secretary-derived context/tool/stale-pointer telemetry can still force checkpoint/downshift.
disagreements.required_change: Bind provenance/freshness per pressure component; stale secretary-derived components are ignored while independently trusted fresh runtime telemetry may contribute.

disagreements.finding: recent_shift_rate_ratio remains caller supplied and thresholded at >=0.50 without canonical numerator/denominator, minimum support, observation window, uncertainty or stateful enter/exit hysteresis.
disagreements.required_change: Derive shift rate from canonical append-only shift history with preregistered support/window/uncertainty and bounded hysteretic release.

disagreements.finding: Anti-thrash can reduce gear_shift_rate while delaying a necessary safe upshift and worsening cycle_completion_latency, verified_closure_per_hour or recovery_latency.
disagreements.required_change: Require paired performance non-regression and bounded release/cooldown; fewer shifts alone is not improvement.

disagreements.finding: Verified Experience still depends on event kind plus booleans/stage strings; exact evidence hash, trusted C/independent-verifier identity and immutable acceptance receipt are not mandatory.
disagreements.required_change: Require immutable evidence identity plus trusted verifier receipt bound to mission/step/scope, freshness/revocation and installation/workspace identity.

disagreements.finding: event_id dedupe exists only within one aggregate invocation. Same evidence under new IDs, cross-run/restart/rollback/poll replay and same-ID rebinding can be re-credited.
disagreements.required_change: Use a durable rollback-resistant event/evidence-lineage acceptance registry: exact replay=no-op, same-evidence/new-ID=lineage duplicate, same-ID/different-binding=IDENTITY_CONFLICT.

disagreements.finding: select_gear_v2_1 recomputes verified and operational deltas directly from caller event fields, bypassing aggregate_experience_events and any future durable-ledger repair.
disagreements.required_change: Both credit classes must come from one immutable AcceptedExperienceReceipt; receipt-less decision calls emit zero credit.

disagreements.finding: Public v2 still exposes DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND through experience_candidate_delta although v2.1 classifies them operational-only.
disagreements.required_change: Unify v2/v2.1 authoritative classification; operational events must never appear in an authoritative Experience-labelled field.

disagreements.finding: 5/4/3 verified credits and operational 1 remain engineering heuristics, not calibrated capability units.
disagreements.required_change: Never interpret aggregate credit as capability truth, Trust, Identity/Personality evidence or promotion threshold.

disagreements.finding: No executable matched paired-baseline protocol establishes speedup; commit count, wake count or awake time are invalid substitutes.
disagreements.required_change: Use sealed matched workloads and paired/crossover baselines over durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency with frozen numerator/denominator provenance, exposure/censoring/order, full assigned-workload coverage, uncertainty and verification/risk non-regression.

statistical_risks: Event-ID poisoning creates first-writer-wins censoring: an invalid or zero-credit record can suppress a later legitimate record with the same identity, biasing observed verified/progress totals downward in an order-dependent way.
Malformed duplicate replay can abort a batch before duplicate detection, creating adversarially selective missingness and invalidating longitudinal ledger statistics.
Malformed verifier metadata on non-verified events can censor later valid evidence and create order-dependent missingness.
v2/v2.1 current-gear normalization mismatch can selectively crash wrapper evaluations and bias candidate-vs-baseline comparisons toward canonically formatted inputs.
Caller-declared secretary freshness/authority conflict invalidates causal routing comparisons; stale numeric pressure may survive secretary-level suppression.
Small-n shift-rate estimates can false-trigger or chatter around a single threshold, while anti-thrash can improve gear_shift_rate and worsen cycle/closure/recovery latency.
verified_progress_density becomes self-reinforcing if policy-created progress is later fed back into routing authority.
Transient event identity plus direct decision-path credit can inflate or censor longitudinal verified/operational totals.
Operational-vs-Experience semantics differ between public v2 and v2.1 interfaces.
5/4/3/1 credits are ordinal engineering heuristics, not capability units.
Speed metrics are numerator/denominator/exposure/order/workload-coverage sensitive and require matched paired/crossover evaluation.
proposed_tests: GB21-EVENT-ID-POISON-094: first record e1=UNKNOWN/zero-credit or unverified VERIFIED_RECOVERY, followed by a valid accepted e1 binding; the first record must not consume identity. If bindings differ, return bounded IDENTITY_CONFLICT rather than duplicate.

GB21-DUPLICATE-PARSE-DOS-095: after one accepted e1, replay e1 with malformed independently_verified followed by valid e2; the replay must be deterministic NO_OP/IDENTITY_CONFLICT and e2 must still be processed, with no batch exception.
GB21-IRRELEVANT-VERIFIER-BATCH-091 + OPERATIONAL-VERIFIER-BATCH-092: malformed verifier metadata on WAIT/HEARTBEAT/DURABLE_PROGRESS cannot abort later valid evidence.
GB21-CURRENT-GEAR-NORMALIZATION-093: current_gear=' G3 ' must normalize once and behave identically to G3 or fail at one typed boundary before inherited routing.
GB21-EVENT-KIND-TYPE-089 + EVENT-KIND-CONSISTENCY-090: all event-kind classification uses one canonical typed value and never raw caller .upper().
GB21-STALE-PRESSURE-PROVENANCE-059 + MIXED-SOURCE-060: stale secretary-derived numeric fields are ignored; trusted independent telemetry remains usable.
GB21-AUTHORITY-DECISION-PROJECTION-028: fresh authority=G1/recovery must project G1 even when fallback caller kwargs are permissive.
GB21-SHIFT-RATE-PROVENANCE-017 + SHIFT-SMALL-N-004 + ANTI-THRASH-CHATTER-040 + RELEASE-041: canonical shift history, adequate support, uncertainty and bounded release are required.
GB21-PROGRESS-DENSITY-FORGE-007: verified_progress_density=1 alone has zero routing/Experience/promotion/authority effect.
GB21-CROSS-RUN-SAME-ID-018 + ROLLBACK-LEDGER-019 + POLL-REPLAY-020 + EVENT-REBIND-021: durable exactly-once and identity-conflict semantics survive restart, rollback and polling.
GB21-VERIFIER-EVIDENCE-011: verified kind/stage without exact evidence hash plus trusted verifier/C receipt gets zero authoritative credit.
GB21-DIRECT-CREDIT-BYPASS-022 + OPERATIONAL-CREDIT-BYPASS-024: every nonzero credit is tied to one immutable accepted receipt.
GB21-V2-V21-CLASSIFIER-CONSISTENCY-078: operational events remain operational-only across all authoritative interfaces.
GB21-CREDIT-SCORE-014: equal aggregate scores from different event mixes cannot imply equivalent capability or trigger promotion.

GB21-PAIRED-SPEED-015 + WAKE-DENOMINATOR-FREEZE-030 + TIME-WINDOW-FREEZE-032 + ORDER-CROSSOVER-036 + ITT-WORKLOAD-COVERAGE-038: speedup requires matched workload, frozen metric provenance, crossover/order control, full assigned-workload coverage and uncertainty/non-regression.

requirements: Fresh exact-current same-runner v1+v2+v2.1 regression PASS on the current six source/test blobs; current Active-8 reports DEFER_EXECUTOR_UNAVAILABLE and zero workflow runs for the exact-byte anchor.
Canonical EventKind and current_gear typed normalization with no partial-path uncaught exception.

Durable rollback-resistant event/evidence-lineage registry plus immutable AcceptedExperienceReceipt; direct decision-path credit disabled without receipt.
Freshness and authority envelopes with exact authority projection; stale secretary-derived numeric telemetry excluded by provenance.
recent_shift_rate_ratio derived from canonical shift history with preregistered minimum support/window/uncertainty and bounded hysteretic release; paired performance non-regression required.
